questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘JAN’ is written as ‘25’, ‘WED’ is written as ‘32’. What is the code for ‘SEP’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic follows is:-

JAN → J + A + N → 10 + 1 + 14 = 25,

WED → W + E + D → 23 + 5 + 4 = 32,

Similarly,

**SEP → S + E + P → 19 + 5 + 16 = 40**.

Thus, the correct answer is “40”.

Which of the following statement is correct about camera I?

options.text: I is between G and S
P is third to left of I
I is to the immediate left of G
I is not the immediate neighbour of N

questions.solution:
1) K is placed third to the left of G.

2) N is placed second to the right of G. (So, G’s place is confirm after this statement)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/121d2fdd54e8481caee8e1cc62b142915d3a7e04eea92065ba74f90ea53c0cfe.png] 

3) S is placed second to the left of I. (only one place left for I i.e. immediate Left oh N)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c11a723d3dffabcbd0a92a7a5afc5a6d3a2ce8e10f0aa93aa1bb3d0d2679fa7a.png] 

Thus, the correct answer is “P is third to left of I”.

16 : 9 ∷ 36 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

16 ÷ 2 = 8; 8 + 1 = 9.

Similarly,

**36 ÷ 2 = 18; 18 + 1 = 19**

Thus, the correct answer is “19”.

questions.question:
In the following question, select the number which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

begin{array}{*{20}{c}} 5&1&3\ 9&9&4\ 6&?&7\ {29}&{22}&{18} end{array}
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

**Column wise:**

**Sum of first three numbers + second number = fourth number**

**In first column:**

5 + 9 + 6 = 20.

⇒ 20 + 9(second number) = 29

In second column:

3 + 4 + 7 = 14;

⇒14 + 4(second number) = 18;

Similarly,

**1 + 9 + ? + 9 (second number) = 22 ; **

⇒ **19 + ? = 22.**

⇒ **? = 3**

Thus, the correct answer is **“3”.**

questions.question:
By interchanging which two signs the equation will be correct?

6 + 9 × 2 - 3 ÷ 4 = 8
questions.solution:
Given equation:- 6 + 9 × 2 - 3 ÷ 4 = 8

By interchanging two signs, check the option:-

1) ÷ and ×

6 + 9 ÷ 2 - 3 × 4 = 8

6 + 4.5 - 3 × 4 = 8

6 + 4.5 - 12 = 8

10.5 - 12 = 8

- 1.5 = 8 False

2) - and +

6 - 9 × 2 + 3 ÷ 4 = 8

6 - 9 × 2 + 0.75 = 8

6 - 18 + 0.75 = 8

6.75 - 18 = 8

- 11.25 = 8 False

3) - and ÷

6 + 9 × 2 ÷ 3 - 4 = 8

6 + 6 - 4 = 8

12 - 4 = 8

**8 = 8 True**

Option 3 is true, so, no need to check the fourth option.

Thus, the correct answer is “- and ÷”.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No T is L.

II. All L are K.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some K are L.

II. Some K are T.

III. No K is L

options.text: Both conclusion II and III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7b9ad3e483ac6a2a3457a44b86ac5e514c78442a2ac15af4b3126dd2c7c5688.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some K are L → True (All L are K so some K are also L)

II. Some K are T → False (No direct relation given, false)

III. No K is L → False (All L are K)

Thus, only conclusion I follow.
